svg.title: Arashima — Reaper's Tempest. Director-approved structure (RUL-2026-10-04-003) / Storm classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Tempest Hymn forks into Gathering Thunderhead then Sundered Sky, or Crimson Downpour then The Storm's Due. Stillness in the Squall forks into Stormwarden's Hide then Unbroken Horizon, or Deadwind Dirge then Silence After Thunder. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu.

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Sundered Sky path + Stillness in the Squall
The Storm's Due path + Stillness in the Squall
Silence After Thunder path + Tempest Hymn
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE ARASHIMA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Director-approved structure (RUL-2026-10-04-003) / Storm classification / forked tree
